records.source: Hey, why are you laughing? He's not even done yet!#$e#You just wait... once we're finished, he'll be one fine snowman.
records.translation: Hoy, bakit ka tumatawa? Hindi pa nga siya tapos!#$e#Hintayin mo lang... kapag tapos na kami, magiging napakagandang taong-niyebe siya.

records.source: You have to temper ice before cutting it, otherwise you can't shape it!
records.translation: Kailangan mong iayon muna ang temperatura ng yelo bago ito putulin, kung hindi ay hindi mo ito mahuhubog!

records.source: Aww... That piggy looks adorable all bundled up!$1
records.translation: Aww... Napakagiliw ng biik na iyan habang nakabalot nang husto!$1

records.source: Look here, it's my secret weapon... a flask of fine spirits, to wet my lips a moment before the whistle sounds...
records.translation: Tingnan mo, ito ang lihim kong sandata... isang prasko ng mainam na alak para basain ang mga labi ko bago tumunog ang sipol...

records.source: I've been spending too much time holed up inside, watching Gridball... it's good to get outside in the crisp winter air.
records.translation: Napakatagal kong nakakulong sa loob at nanonood ng Gridball... mabuting lumabas sa preskong hangin ng taglamig.

records.source: Hmm? How did you get here?#$e#Pay no attention to me. I'm simply observing...
records.translation: Hmm? Paano ka nakarating dito?#$e#Huwag mo akong pansinin. Nagmamasid lamang ako...

records.source: I shouldn't have waxed my moustache this morning, it's frozen solid! Oh dear...$2#$e#Well, if you need an ice pick, you know where to find me...$h
records.translation: Hindi ko sana nilagyan ng pagkit ang bigote ko kaninang umaga, nanigas ito sa yelo! Naku...$2#$e#Kung kailangan mo ng pantibag ng yelo, alam mo kung saan ako matatagpuan...$h

records.source: Don't the fish get cold under there?$3
records.translation: Hindi ba nilalamig ang mga isda sa ilalim niyan?$3

records.source: My big brother is helping me build a snowman!$0
records.translation: Tinutulungan ako ni Kuya na gumawa ng taong-niyebe!$0

records.source: This time of year isn't so bad. No bugs during winter...#$e#Think you can beat Willy this year? He's a tough competitor...
records.translation: Hindi naman ganoon kasama ang panahong ito. Walang mga kulisap sa taglamig...#$e#Sa tingin mo, matatalo mo si Willy ngayong taon? Mahusay siyang kalaban...

records.source: *crunch* *crunch* Snow makes a funny noise when you step on it!$1
records.translation: *langutngot* *langutngot* Nakakatawa ang tunog ng niyebe kapag inaapakan!$1

records.source: I'll be rooting for you in the fishing competition.
records.translation: Susuportahan kita sa paligsahan sa pangingisda.

records.source: I'm dreaming of our warm fire back home...$l
records.translation: Pinapangarap ko ang mainit nating apoy sa bahay...$l

records.source: I know you'll beat me in the fishing competition, but I don't mind. I'm just here for the fun of it.$h
records.translation: Alam kong matatalo mo ako sa paligsahan sa pangingisda, pero ayos lang. Narito lang ako para magsaya.$h

records.source: $y 'Hey, @. Ready for some ice fishing?_Yes. I'll do my best!_That's the spirit!$h_Yes, and I'm going to beat you!_We'll see.$h_To be honest, no. I'm bad at fishing._Well, then think of it as good practice!$h'
records.translation: $y 'Hoy, @. Handa ka na bang mangisda sa yelo?_Oo. Gagawin ko ang lahat!_Iyan ang gusto ko!$h_Oo, at tatalunin kita!_Tingnan natin.$h_Sa totoo lang, hindi. Hindi ako mahusay mangisda._Kung gayon, isipin mo na lang na magandang pagsasanay ito!$h'

records.source: Someday, I should teach you how to sculpt with ice! It would be fun!$h#$e#I'd be very curious to see what you'd come up with.
records.translation: Balang araw, dapat kitang turuang maglilok gamit ang yelo! Magiging masaya iyon!$h#$e#Sabik akong makita kung ano ang maiisip mong gawin.

records.source: You'll do great out there, honey! Just stay calm and focused.
records.translation: Magiging mahusay ka roon, mahal! Kumalma ka lang at magpokus.

records.source: Ta da! It's you!#$e#What? You don't see the resemblance? I think it's perfect!
records.translation: Ta-da! Ikaw iyan!#$e#Ano? Hindi mo nakikita ang pagkakahawig? Sa tingin ko, perpekto ito!

records.source: Remember when we sat at the old pond and shared a beer? That was around here somewhere.#$e#Well, it's best not to dwell in the past... even the good memories bring me pain.
records.translation: Naaalala mo noong umupo tayo sa lumang lawa at nagsalo ng serbesa? Dito iyon sa paligid.#$e#Pero pinakamabuting huwag palaging balikan ang nakaraan... kahit ang magagandang alaala ay nagpapasakit sa akin.

records.source: Aye, the whole town'll be watchin' our little tournament today. Let's give them all a good show.
records.translation: Aye, manonood ang buong bayan sa munting paligsahan natin ngayon. Bigyan natin sila ng magandang palabas.
